entropy_burst.source: RMS token-to-token residual entropy difference per layer

max_token_entropy.source: max-token entropy at every attention/MLP/residual layer

top1_sharpness.source: mean_t[entropy + log p(top1)] per residual layer

selection_history: Chosen after two negative frozen searches, geometry/frequency/readout screens, and an explicit component subset audit on these same 13 eligible cells.
success_target: macro AUROC above both the best-single-layer oracle and TriLens grouped L2 probe
